PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to developing and presenting a package of technical amendments to streamline development projects presented under Senate Bill (SB) 79.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Motion (Yaroslavsky - Blumenfield, et al.), relative to developing and presenting a package of technical amendments to streamline development projects presented under SB 79.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable
Community Impact Statement:
Yes Against:
Westside Neighborhood Council Westwood Neighborhood Council For: North Westwood Neighborhood Council
(Continued from Council meeting date of October 30, 2026.)
summary: Motion directing Planning to bring technical amendments to speed up approvals of projects under state Senate Bill 79, aligned with Missing Middle LA, and asking for a broader implementation strategy with Building and Safety.

details.action: motion directing amendments and implementation report
